 The Oura Ring 4 is $249 at Amazon, Best Buy and Target for silver and black, matching last year's Black Friday price; it hit $226 at Amazon in June 2026.
 Oura rolled Health Radar, live activity tracking and GLP-1 Insights to the Ring 4, so the Ring 5's advantage is mainly a 40% smaller body and one extra day of rated battery.
 Oura's S-1 filing says some Ring 4 batches had battery problems, adding to an $84.4 million rise in warranty expense in fiscal 2025.
 The Oura Ring 4 is down to $249 at Amazon, Best Buy and Target, $150 under the Oura Ring 5, and since Oura pushed most of the Ring 5’s new software to the Ring 4 this summer, that gap now pays for size and comfort rather than features. With retailers discounting the older ring two weeks before Black Friday, buyers are asking whether it’s a bargain or a leftover. Here’s how the Ring 4 compares with the Gen3 and Ring 5, what owners say after two years, how it stacks up against rings with no subscription, and who should take this deal. 
 Is $249 the Lowest Price the Oura Ring 4 Has Ever Hit? 
 Best Choice Oura Ring 4 Smart Ring 
   4/5 Overview

 Oura Ring 4 uses unique sizing different from standard jewelry rings

 Check Price See latest price on Amazon
 The $249 price on the Oura Ring 4 matches last year’s Black Friday deal rather than beating it, because silver and black Ring 4s dropped to $249 at Amazon, Best Buy, Target and Walmart in late November 2025, and in late June 2026, just after the Ring 5 launched, Droid Life spotted the ring as low as $226 at Amazon. So this is a good price but not a record one, and it covers silver and black only, while Oura’s own store still listed the silver and stealth Ring 4 at $349 and gold at $399 when we checked on November 13. 
 Our reading is that a much deeper Black Friday cut is unlikely, since the two biggest Ring 4 sales of the past year landed at $249 and $226, which is also below the roughly $244 our smart ring Black Friday deals guide expected. If your size is in stock today, waiting two weeks is likely to save you very little.

 The Oura Ring 4’s real upgrades over the Gen3 sit inside the ring rather than on the spec sheet. According to Oura’s Ring 4 launch announcement , the ring introduced Smart Sensing, an array of 18 light paths that reads your finger through PPG (photoplethysmography, the green and red light sensors that measure blood flow), and it replaced the Gen3’s raised sensor bumps with recessed sensors under a titanium coating, so the inside is smooth. It also widened the size range to 4 through 15, which Oura calls the widest on the market. 
 The Oura Ring 5, by contrast, is mostly a hardware diet, since Oura says it’s about 40% smaller than the Ring 4, at 2.28mm thick and 6.09mm wide, with one more day of rated battery and an optional charging case. What it didn’t keep was the Ring 4’s size range, because the Ring 5 only comes in sizes 6 to 13. The software story points the other way, because Oura began rolling Health Radar, live activity tracking on your phone’s lock screen, GLP-1 Insights, lab uploads and several Oura Labs features to Gen3 and Ring 4 owners in June, so a Ring 4 with an active membership gets nearly the same app as the newer ring. 
 What Oura Ring 4 Owners Say After Two Years 
 Oura Ring 5 Smart Ring 
   4.5/5 Overview 
 40% smaller than the previous generation
 Oura Ring 5 uses unique sizing different from standard jewelry
 Oura tracks over 50 health metrics, including sleep, activity, stress
 View deal The first reactions in Reddit’s r/ouraring launch thread in October 2024 set the tone. Several owners were disappointed that the Ring 4 was essentially as thick as the Gen3, one saying she’d hoped for something less bulky on small fingers, while others liked the new sizes and smooth titanium interior but didn’t think either justified replacing a working Gen3. Gold and rose gold costing more than silver also drew the same “pink tax” complaints the Gen3 had. 
 Battery became the bigger story about a year in. Owners in r/ouraring described their Ring 4 dropping from five days to every other day, and Oura has since confirmed part of that in its S-1 filing with the SEC, saying certain Ring 4 production batches had battery performance problems that helped push its warranty expense up by $84.4 million in fiscal 2025. Oura replaced affected rings for free, sometimes after the one-year warranty had run out, but it hasn’t said which batches, sizes or dates were affected. Other owners rate it higher for sleep than workouts, and one switched to a RingConn Gen 2 after charging the Oura three times a week.

 The Oura Ring 4 at $249 is the cheapest ring here on day one, but the membership flips that within about 17 months against the RingConn Gen 3, since the $100 price gap equals roughly 17 monthly payments of $5.99. Against Samsung’s Galaxy Ring, which needs no subscription but only works with Android phones, the crossover comes at about 25 months. RingConn’s Gen 3 also adds a vibration motor for alerts and a 14-day rating, which is why we covered how the RingConn Gen 3 compares to the Oura Ring 5 separately. What the subscription buys is Oura’s app, which is moving toward medical care after Oura’s $625 million Counsel Health deal . 
 The $150 Gap Buys Comfort, Not Features 
 Memeburn’s call on the Oura Ring 4 at $249 is that it’s the better buy than the Ring 5 for anyone who wears a size 4, 5, 14 or 15, and for anyone wearing the ring on a ring or middle finger, where a 0.6mm difference in thickness matters less. Two years of the Ring 4 including membership comes to $388.98, less than the Ring 5’s sticker price alone, and since Oura moved Health Radar and live activity tracking to the Ring 4, the extra $150 mostly buys a smaller body and one more day of rated battery. If you plan to wear the ring on your index finger, have slim fingers or are replacing a Gen3 you found bulky, the Ring 5’s size is the upgrade Ring 4 owners asked for in 2024. 
 The condition that would change this advice is the battery. Buy from Oura or an authorized retailer so the one-year warranty applies, check how many days you get in the first few weeks, and contact Oura support if it falls well short of five days, since the company has already replaced affected rings for free.

 FAQs 
 Is the Oura Ring 4 still worth buying in 2026?   
 The Oura Ring 4 gets nearly the same app features as the Ring 5, including Health Radar and live activity tracking, and it comes in more sizes (4 to 15). At $249 it costs $150 less than the Ring 5, though it’s thicker and has one less day of rated battery. 
 What is the difference between the Oura Ring 4 and Ring 5?   
 The Oura Ring 5 is about 40% smaller, at 2.28mm thick and 6.09mm wide compared with 2.88mm and 7.9mm for the Ring 4. It’s rated for 6 to 9 days of battery against 5 to 8, but it only comes in sizes 6 to 13. 
 Does the Oura Ring 4 have a battery problem?   
 Oura said in its S-1 filing that certain Ring 4 production batches had battery performance problems, which helped raise its warranty expense by $84.4 million in fiscal 2025. Oura replaced affected rings for free, in some cases after the warranty had ended.
